states.label: Shell concept Sales and Service trial
states.description: Reference-only private Figma prototype: navy rail, grouped flyout, fixed-query command palette, independent snapshot scrolling, pinned-menu restoration and desktop/phone journeys. No runtime renderer or acceptance claim.

gaps.expected: A shared shell preserves context, panels, reachable controls and accepted phone rules across Sales and Service.
gaps.actual: The separate concept now has 66 connected screens, compact 390 x 844 and 320 x 568 phone lists, distinct record actions, state-specific Service lists and a phone Schedule handover. Cross-workspace re-entry resets the fixed Service example. The 72 px rail, 768 px breakpoint and reduced phone controls remain proposed departures; application code is unchanged.
gaps.action: Review the player walkthrough in PPO-SHELL-CONCEPT-PROTOTYPE-DEC, resolve state continuity and phone coverage, reconcile accepted phone rules, then verify focus, zoom and physical devices before adoption.

states.label: Concept preview and checked row
states.description: Reference only: deal-name click opens preview with an empty checkbox; checkbox creates the separate checked-row/count state; clearing selection leaves preview open.

states.label: Concept save and recovery journey
states.description: Reference only: predefined draft edit, saving, saved, Undo, failed retry, offline and newer-version resolution. Explicit issue/send confirmation ends at queued, not delivered.

states.label: Concept fitted dialogs and phone confirmation
states.description: Reference only: content-sized Service authorisation, delivery edit, conflict resolution and issue/send dialogs with full-shell scrims; 390 and 320 phone confirmation sheets retain consequences and 44 px actions. Cancel/Escape return to invoking context.

gaps.expected: A confirmation preserves the exact invoking record values and supports accessible modal interaction.
gaps.actual: The issue/send fixture uses the saved 8 December quote background and result across invoking quote states. Cancellation returns correctly. Focus trapping, focus return and screen-reader semantics remain unproven.
gaps.action: Make issue confirmation/result fixtures stateful and verify modal behaviour in the application before adoption.
